mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0% and rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month, it signals a tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% and rises by >0.5pp in a month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in residential investment (RSAFS) signals a potential housing demand slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO increases over the past month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year and housing starts (HOUST) falls below 1.2 million units, it signals a cooling demand environment that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and HOUST < 1.2 million (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a potential labor market recovery that boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines in a high-unemployment regime (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a year-over-year CPIAUCSL change below 2.0% signals a well-managed monetary easing that reduces real interest rates without inflation fears, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).
